signature.why: The cascade half. Every field list runs 3 Living End and at least one full four-copy cascade spell, and it is the only combination in Modern that casts a sorcery it never pays for: every cascade spell in the deck costs three, so Living End is the sole hit. Seven is the floor a single-cascade-spell build runs, not the eleven the common Violent Outburst plus Shardless Agent list has.

The bodies the cascade returns, all of which reach the graveyard for free. Wistfulness and Living End do nothing off an empty yard, so a build of this archetype cannot omit the cyclers - which eight of them it runs is a curve decision.

The free interaction, 4-of in 10/10 field lists. These are pitched, not cast: a deck whose manabase makes eleven green and thirteen blue sources holds them up on the turn it cascades, which is the whole reason this shell is three colours.
